sources.label: Morphe patches: AML mod loader and PC mod ports for GTA: San Andreas - Definitiv
sources.author: GTA SA DE Mods (RAZORRZR0)
patch_list: Adds Rubbish-DE by H4V3NART: loose litter on the streets that blows around when vehicles pass. Builds its model pak from the game's own files at the first start, so no game files are shipped.

Adds CLEO Android 2.0.1, which runs CLEO scripts with the swipe-down CLEO menu. Installs 14 GTA SA scripts in Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/cleo/; the .csa ones, such as invincibility and regeneration, always run, so delete the o…
Adds about 16,000 map props from Project Props 4 by user-grinch. Downloads the placements from github.com/user-grinch/Project-Props while patching, so it needs internet.
Adds ModMenu, an in-game menu that changes the settings of the other mods while playing.

Adds SkyGfx: PS2 colours and timecyc, radiosity, distant lamp coronas and post effects, the PC graphics settings the phone menu hides (draw distance, shadows, anti-aliasing and more) and AMD FSR 1 upscaling.

Adds GTA Prop Fix, which restores the original game's physics for knocked-over props: lamp posts, traffic lights, signs, bins and hydrants fall and roll with world and car collision instead of DE's physics, and broken pieces land on the gr…

Loads Unreal .pak mod files from Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/paks/ when the game starts, above the game's own paks, so PC Definitive Edition pak mods work as-is. Copy the .pak files there and restart the game.
Plays one of the game's eight loading-screen themes while a save loads, like the PC SALoadingMusic mod.
